description: This file contains the implementation of the EndpointOptionsProvider class, which is responsible for configuring EndpointOptions instances, specifically resolving and setting the AdvertisedIPAddress if it is not already set. It includes logic for handling IP address resolution, error handling, and logging.

classes.name: EndpointOptionsProvider
classes.description: A class that performs post-configuration of EndpointOptions, primarily resolving the advertised IP address if not provided.

methods.name: PostConfigure
methods.description: Sets the AdvertisedIPAddress in EndpointOptions if it is null, resolving IP addresses as needed and handling exceptions.
